detail.title: HDMI 2.0 Cable with Blue Metal Cap - 15 Meters
detail.overview: The Ant Esports AEH115 is a 15-metre HDMI 2.0 cable finished with a distinctive blue metal connector cap and 24K gold-plated contacts for reliable, corrosion-resistant connections over time. Rated for 18Gbps bandwidth, it supports the full range of HDTV resolutions and refresh rates for sharp, lag-free video and audio across extended runs common in home theatres or conference rooms. Its sturdy build and premium connector finish make it a dependable choice wherever a source device and display sit far apart.
